0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Mhon Mon is being plagued by hellish beasts and an empty stomach.

24.original: Lie in wait for the wandering weapon.

48.original: Oooh! What to do? What to do?

49.original: I want to make traditional Mord stew and I only need one more ingredient─Amber weed.

50.original: But it has become scarce around here, except for in an area that is plagued by evil weapons!

51.original: Funny name, not so funny when they are trying to kill you, though! There is an especially horrible one called the wandering weapon who the others seem to follow.

52.original: If you could get rid of it, the rest might leave us alone. Then I can finally harvest Amber weed in peace. So, will you help us?

53.original: I hate that wandering weapon and its big, stupid face!

54.original: You did it? Hooray! Now that Amber weed will be mine! Heh heh heh...

55.original: But I wonder if the other evil weapons will come back... I hear they were made by the mages of Nabaath Areng from enchanted swords. Do not ask me how they ended up looking like that, though!

56.original: Apparently, their masters disappeared after the Flood. With no one to command them, they have been prowling around Amber, attacking everything that comes close!

57.original: I hope that by getting rid of the wandering weapon, they will stay away for a while, but who can say? All I know is, I can make my stew now! My stomach thanks you!
